scope: Static safety preflight for a single isolated two-file rollback rehearsal; not proof that rollback has run

requirements.evidence: compare_assets samples datetime.now(timezone.utc) once after argument checks and before traversing histories; all source and observation checks reuse now_utc.

Every observation in every AssetHistory is checked against now_utc.date() before it is stored in checked and before common-date intersection. Future non-common rows cannot disappear through alignment.

date.fromisoformat is followed by isinstance(raw_day,str) and raw_day == day.isoformat(); basic ISO and week dates are rejected. Existing CSV date.strip() is intentionally retained and is outside the raw-whitespace rejection scope.
Source timestamps are normalized to UTC and rejected only when strictly greater than now_utc + timedelta(minutes=5), preserving the inclusive exact boundary.

Observed source diff is core/multi_asset_comparison.py +6/-1 plus new 18-test module. Existing currency, provenance, price, calendar-gap, and no-fill behavior remains intact. The separately observed docs/ANKA_OPERATIONS.jsonl changes are operation records, not app code.

rollback_static_checks.branch_and_base: Exact branch and BASE assertions precede mutation.
rollback_static_checks.source_preconditions: Exact two candidate SHA256 values checked before rollback; path containment and symlink checks present.
rollback_static_checks.backup: Two exact-byte backups are created in a new evidence directory and checked against expected hashes before mutation.
rollback_static_checks.mutation: Only the new test is moved to task evidence; the comparison module is written from the base Git blob in the verified CRLF worktree convention. No recursive delete, reset, checkout, clean, or force operation.
rollback_static_checks.rollback_verification: Base Git blob equality, empty core diff, test absence, and only documentation tracked diffs are asserted.
rollback_static_checks.reinstatement: Base bytes and test absence are checked first; backup and retired-test hashes are checked before restoring; final two source hashes are checked.
rollback_static_checks.primary: Helper check_primary reads a 28-file preservation manifest and compares file hashes, status, branch, and HEAD. Static review found no write to primary application files. This reviewer did not execute it.
rollback_static_checks.offline_runner: Audit guard is registered before ANKA/provider imports, Qt uses offscreen and an isolated layout path, and passing reports require no failures, errors, skips, denied events, or source hash changes.
rollback_static_checks.policies: No approval-policy, permission, credential, model, provider, or trading changes in the reviewed patch or helpers.

execution_conditions: Run the helper with a normal Python invocation; do not use -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE, because safety preconditions use assert.
Maintain exclusive access to the isolated candidate while the sequential rollback and reinstate operations run.

Run rollback, then a fresh guarded baseline suite, then reinstate; validate the baseline has exactly 19 tests, zero failures/errors/skips, correct baseline source identity, and a timestamp belonging to this rehearsal. The reinstate helper itself only checks baseline status and count.
Retain the task evidence snapshots until reinstatement source hashes and primary preservation have been confirmed by the coordinator.
The helper is sequential and non-atomic. If a step fails, stop and inspect the preserved exact-byte snapshots before continuing.

execution_evidence.old_candidate_restore: Saved author old_restore.json reports PASS with CRLF correction and primary 28/28 preservation; historical evidence only.

previous_reviewer_tests.guard_self_checks: Saved evidence records DNS and child-process denial self-checks, then zero unexpected denied events.
